title: Concise Polygenic Models for Cancer-Specific Identification of Drug-Sensitive Tumors from Their Multi-Omics Profiles.
summary: XGBoost with feature selection yields 118 validated cell-line drug-response models for 62 drugs across five cancer types using four omics profiles; validation is on the source pharmacogenomic datasets, not clinical patient response. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
